_doc: Manual severity flags merged on top of the GitHub releases list. Edit, redeploy, and the next hourly refresh picks it up. Versions below `minimumSupported` are reported as deprecated. Per-version `severities` entries either flag a release as a security update (use `severity: "security"` and optionally an `advisory: "GHSA-..."`) or mark an old release as deprecated (`severity: "deprecated"`).
